Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows markedly elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible heart failure or cardiac strain. HbA1c is high, indicating suboptimal glycemic control (diabetes). Leukopenia and increased RDW may reflect underlying chronic disease or nutritional deficiency. Mildly low total CO₂ may suggest metabolic acidosis. Other parameters, including renal, liver, and lipid profiles, are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended.
